facts.fact: Billie 十年后回到她当年逃离的华盛顿老家，已离开纽约、与 Graham 分手。
facts.anchor: After ten years, I’ll be back in the very place that I happily ran away from. I thought when I left, that would be it.

facts.fact: 她把全部家当塞进后备箱就出发——没有计划，油箱只有半箱油。
facts.anchor: I stuck all of my belongings in my trunk, and I mean all of my belongings, I figured I’d see what would happen. No plan. Half a tank of gas ready to go.

facts.fact: 父亲身边是「他那可怕的妻子」（Eloise），是她紧张害怕的对象之一。
facts.anchor: it’s just my dad. Him and his horrible wife.

facts.fact: 父母的房子 2,500 平方英尺，对两个人来说太空了。
facts.anchor: Twenty-five hundred square feet to be exact. Far too much space for only two people.

facts.fact: 她把车停进车道后盯着车库门整整五分钟，一度想「明天再来、先给父亲打电话」。
facts.anchor: I place my car in park and stare at the garage door for five whole minutes.

facts.fact: 当年她搬家时父亲没有阻止 Eloise「画下界线」——她担心这次父亲照样不会站在她这边。
facts.anchor: he didn’t stop her from drawing it herself.

facts.fact: 就在她几乎转身离开时门开了——父亲哽咽着叫出她的名字。
facts.anchor: His voice chokes as he speaks. “Billie?”

facts.fact: 父亲含泪拥抱她、唤她 baby girl，她抱得更紧、哭得更凶。
